# Horton International

> Global executive search and management consulting firm specializing in C-suite recruitment, talent strategy, and organizational leadership across multiple industries and regions.

Horton International is a leading international executive search firm with offices spanning the Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The firm provides specialized recruitment and consulting services across key sectors including technology, financial services, industrial, pharmaceutical, consumer goods, and energy.

## Key Topics

- Executive Search
- Talent Acquisition
- Management Consulting
- Leadership Recruitment
- Talent Strategy
- C-Suite Placement
- Organizational Consulting
- Global Offices
- Digital Transformation

- Succession Planning
- Board-Level Recruitment
- Sector Specialization
- Psychometric Assessment
- Global Services

- [Technology & IT](https://hortoninternational.com/industries/digitization-it-technology): Technology and IT executive search with digital transformation expertise

- [Industrial & Manufacturing](https://hortoninternational.com/industries/industrial): Industrial and manufacturing executive search with Industry 4.0 expertise
